campaign: one continuing campaign across candidates and replacement datasets

development.as_run_limit: The closed 108-opportunity pilot omitted a separate account-scope family; partial-account questions within other families do not fulfill that coverage obligation.
development.history: The original 36 cases and pilot remain unchanged. The supplement repairs prospective development coverage, not the historical pilot result.

admission.coverage_review: Independently inspect all four task types in every family; family labels and software shape checks alone do not prove substantive coverage.

primary_outcome: correct useful completion of every supported structured obligation and appropriate withholding of unsupported conclusions
native_read_only_scope: Interpretation and reconciliation of identical supplied synthetic calculation evidence; not production deterministic-engine execution
prose_assessment: separate calibrated full-artifact review, not established by the deterministic server
failed_attempts: preserved and counted; no retries with new request names
case_split: underlying scenario and source family, never number or ticker substitutions

confirmation.size_source: public pilot discordance; fixed before confirmation
confirmation.batch_alpha: 0.05 / 2^j, j starts at 1 and never resets
confirmation.interval: exact Clopper-Pearson on independent binary family outcomes
confirmation.cohort_release: One immutable cohort with fixed paired family sample across at most 32 bounded chunks. No member receipt or cohort aggregate before every member closes and seals.
confirmation.alpha_scope: One witness-owned analysis slot per whole cohort; chunk indices do not grant alpha. Replacements and candidates remain in the original campaign.
confirmation.power_limit: Sizing is conditional on task distribution, valid independent families and feasible underlying improvement; a ceiling-limited public pilot cannot establish guaranteed power.

acceptance.controls: all deterministic and calibrated reviewer controls functioning
acceptance.operational_pilot: seven actual scheduled cycles including Sunday; separate rolling 30-day record
